principles.source_of_truth: Cloud repository is the ONLY source of truth
principles.rebuild_over_patch: When in doubt, rebuild from source — don't patch
principles.audit_after_milestone: Every milestone gets a full audit before proceeding
principles.no_memory_trust: Never trust chat memory — always pull from cloud

file_standards.wrapper_policy: All .ts, .tsx, .py files must be wrapped in .md for cloud storage
file_standards.versioning: schema_version field in every JSON file

change_management.rollback: Previous versions preserved in cloud history

artifact_policy.max_size: Single artifact per deliverable when possible
artifact_policy.chunking: If too large, split into numbered parts (Part 1/2, Part 2/2)

security.ip_stripping: All Amazon/corporate IP must be removed before public push
security.private_data: Memoir files go in private repo only
